Package org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.openlineage.controls

Enum Class OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType>
org.odpi.openmetadata.adapters.connectors.integration.openlineage.controls.OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType>, Constable
public enum OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType extends Enum<OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType>
OpenLineageCataloguerTemplateType defines the names that the Open Lineage Cataloguer integration connector uses to choose the catalog template for a job or dataset that is not catalogued yet, and the default template for each name. The names are built from values found in the OpenLineage events:
  • job:{integration}:{jobType}, job:{integration} and job:*:{jobType} - from the integration and jobType values of the job's jobType facet.
  • dataset:{scheme}:{variant} and dataset:{scheme} - from the scheme of the dataset's namespace (the part before ://). The variant is folder when the dataset's name ends in a slash, and subscription for a Google Pub/Sub subscription.
  • job:* and dataset:* - any job or dataset that has no more specific name. These have no default template.
The connector tries the names for a job or dataset from the most specific to the least specific and uses the first one that has a template. The same names are used in the templates property of the connector's catalog targets to replace the default template for a name, or to supply a template for a name that has no default (such as an integration or namespace scheme that is not listed here). Names are not case-sensitive.

      public static List<String> getDataSetTemplateNames(String rawScheme, String canonicalScheme, String dataSetName)
      Return the template names for a dataset, from the most specific to the least specific. The scheme as it appears in the namespace comes before the canonical scheme, so that (for example) sqlserver can have a different template from mssql.
      Parameters:
      rawScheme - scheme as it appears in the dataset's namespace (may be null)
      canonicalScheme - canonical form of the scheme (may be null)
      dataSetName - name of the dataset (may be null)
      Returns:
      list of template names
